Extract console interaction into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody: Move Amy's welcome message, command input, separators, and farewell into a dedicated Ui class. This reduces presentation concerns in the application entry point while preserving the existing command behavior and output exactly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser class
commitResults.messageBody: Move task-command recognition and Todo, Deadline, and Event construction out of Amy and into Parser. This separates command interpretation from the application loop while preserving all existing validation messages and behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task collection into TaskList class
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate Amy's task collection behind TaskList operations for construction, inspection, addition, removal, and persistence access. This reduces direct ArrayList handling in the application loop without changing command behavior.

Give Storage an explicit file path and convert persistence operations to instance methods. Amy now owns a Storage dependency, removing the fixed global save-file configuration while preserving the existing storage format and user-visible behavior.

Centralize ordinary user-facing response output behind Ui.showMessage, including list displays, task confirmations, and command errors. This leaves Amy focused on coordinating parser, task list, and storage responsibilities while preserving the exact console transcript.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task status mutations into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Add mark and unmark operations to TaskList and update Amy to delegate task state changes. This completes encapsulation of the task collection's core mutations without changing command validation or user-visible behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Consolidate Amy into an object-oriented application
commitResults.messageBody: Give Amy explicit Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList fields; load tasks in the constructor; move the command loop into run; and reduce main to a simple launcher. This completes the requested class extraction structure while preserving all existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand UI plan with command edge cases
commitResults.messageBody: Add regression cases for blank input and whitespace-trimmed exit commands, and record the successful 27-case session. These tests cover command-boundary behavior introduced by the parser and UI separation.

Move application classes under amy and task model classes under amy.task. Update package declarations, cross-package imports, the UI test launcher, and README paths so src/main/java remains the source root and the packaged entry point runs correctly.
Configure the Gradle application plugin to launch amy.Amy, matching the packaged source structure after the package organization refactor.
Add JUnit 5 tests covering empty-list initialization, insertion order, removal, marking, and unmarking. These cases exercise the public TaskList operations with clear observable outcomes.
Add tests for initialized task lists, middle-item removal and ordering, and the persistence list view. Together with the existing cases, every public TaskList operation now has direct JUnit coverage.

Add focused Parser tests for command recognition, todo, deadline, event, and validation branches, while documenting the target of covering the highest-value approximately 50% of methods and updating tests after every code change.
Configure the Shadow plugin to produce build/libs/amy.jar, matching the Amy application name while retaining amy.Amy as the executable entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add project Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody: Create the project-specific seedu-java-coding-standard skill based on the SE-EDU intermediate Java conventions, mandate it in AGENTS.md, and align existing public methods with the documented formatting and Javadoc rules.

Create the project-specific seedu-git-standard skill from the SE-EDU Git conventions and mandate it in AGENTS.md. Require meaningful branch names and commit messages that explain what changed and why.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java sources with project standard
commitResults.messageBody: Standardize import grouping and ordering, expand public API documentation, and format compact method declarations. Preserve the existing application behavior while making the code conform to the project-specific SE-EDU Java conventions.
Add descriptive Javadoc headers to the TaskList API and format the Deadline override consistently. Improve discoverability of the public task-list operations while preserving application behavior.
Add the missing class-level JavaDoc to Amy so its coordination role is clear alongside the documented constructor and public methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody: Allow users to search task descriptions with a case-insensitive find command. Display matching tasks with their original list numbers, report missing keywords, and cover matching and no-match behavior in the UI plan.
